newsitem.title: USA: Dow falls 50 points, NYSE sets curbs again.
newsitem.headline: Dow falls 50 points, NYSE sets curbs again.

text.p: Wall Street stocks tumbled in the final moments of trading, as a late sell program helped pull the Dow industrials sharply lower.
The Dow fell 51 to 6254, triggering index-arbitrage trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange for the second time. Earlier, curbs were imposed when the Dow rose 50 points.
Birinyi Associates, which tracks program trading activity, said a sell program was currently underway on the NYSE. The firm could not calculate the impact of the program.
